description: Gemini Web seat: each tell is typed into Gemini in a signed-in browser seat and Gemini's answer comes back as a tell, one conversation per correspondent. It needs an a8s-browser seat whose Chrome profile a person has already signed in to Gemini by hand — this node never signs in. Register it with the launcher path and that seat as per-node vars, e.g. `a8s add gemini ~/agents/gemini gemini-web --A8S_GEMINI_WEB=/path/to/a8s-gemini-web --A8S_GEMINI_BROWSER_SEAT=gemini-profile --A8S_GEMINI_ALLOW=example-sender` — an unset allowlist means the seat refuses everyone. Optional: `a8s vars gemini set A8S_GEMINI_MODEL '2.5 Pro'` picks a model as Gemini's own menu labels it when a conversation is created (unset takes Gemini's default), and `a8s vars gemini set A8S_GEMINI_BROWSER_CMD /path/to/a8s-browser` names the a8s-browser launcher when a wake's PATH does not carry it.
